items.title: Welcome and match intro
items.text: Good afternoon (evening), ladies and gentlemen! Today at … (arena), as part of … (tournament), the game will be played between … (home) and … (visitors).

items.title: Team rosters
items.text:
We present the line-ups of today’s teams.

Line-up of … (visitors).
Goalkeepers:
Number, first name, last name

Line-up of … (home).

Number, first name, last name

items.title: Opening and national anthem
items.text: The game between … (home) and … (visitors) is declared open! Please rise for the national anthem.

items.title: Officials
items.text: The officials for today’s game: referees …, linesmen …

items.title: Starting goalkeepers
items.text: In goal for … (visitors): … (name, number); for … (home): … (name, number).

items.title: Safety announcement
items.text: Dear spectators! Please treat the participants and other fans with respect. Keep order in the stands. Report any unattended items to security. Smoking and alcohol are prohibited. Thank you.

items.title: Goal — no assists
items.text: Goal scored by … (name, number).

items.title: Goal — one assist
items.text: Assisted by … (name, number), goal scored by … (name, number).

items.title: Goal — two assists
items.text: Assisted by … (name, number) and … (name, number), goal scored by … (name, number).

items.title: No goal — after stoppage
items.text: No goal has been scored because the puck was scored after the stoppage of play.

items.title: No goal — after period
items.text: No goal has been scored because the puck crossed the goal line after the end of the period.

items.title: No goal — did not cross line
items.text: No goal has been scored because the puck did not completely cross the goal line.

items.title: No goal — dislodged net
items.text: No goal has been scored because the puck was scored into a dislodged net.

items.title: No goal — kicked/directed
items.text: No goal has been scored because the puck was directed into the net by a kick (hand, head or body).

items.title: No goal — high stick
items.text: No goal has been scored because the puck was directed into the net with a high stick.

items.title: No goal — goaltender interference
items.text: No goal has been scored due to goaltender interference.

items.title: No goal — crease violation
items.text: No goal has been scored due to goaltender interference / crease violation.

items.title: No goal — rebound on penalty shot
items.text: No goal has been scored because the puck was scored on a rebound (penalty shot or shootout).

items.title: Correction — goal scorer
items.text: Attention! Correction: goal number … into the net of …, assisted by … and …, scored by … (name, number).

items.title: Correction — assists
items.text: Goal number … into the net of … scored by … (name, number), assisted by … and …

items.text: One minute left in the second period.

items.title: Two minutes left — 3rd period
items.text: Two minutes left in the third period.

items.title: Team at full strength
items.text: Team … is playing at full strength.

items.title: Both teams at full strength
items.text: Both teams are playing at full strength.

items.title: Goalkeeper change
items.text: Goalkeeper change for team …. In goal: … (name, number), time …

items.title: Premature goalkeeper change

items.title: Timeout
items.text: Time out for team …

items.title: Attendance
items.text: Attendance for today’s game between … is … spectators! Thank you for your support!

items.title: Score after 1st period
items.text: Score after the first period …, … leads.

items.title: Score after 2nd period
items.text: Score after the second period …, … leads.

items.title: Penalty shot
items.text: A penalty shot is awarded against team … for …. The penalty shot will be taken by … (name, number).

items.title: Game-winning shots
items.text: According to the tournament regulations, if the game is tied after regulation (and overtime), a shootout will determine the winner. Team … will shoot first.

items.title: Clock by stopwatch
items.text: Game time is being kept by the official stopwatch.

items.title: Penalty time by stopwatch
items.text: Penalty time is being kept by the official stopwatch. Time remaining for penalized player … of team …: … minutes and … seconds.

items.title: Scoreboard time correct
items.text: The scoreboard time is correct.

items.title: Ice surface problem
items.text: Ladies and gentlemen, before the game can continue the ice surface must be prepared again. Player and official safety is our top priority. Thank you for your understanding!

items.title: Ice ready — resume
items.text: Ladies and gentlemen, the game will resume in … minutes. Thank you for your understanding!

items.title: Coach’s challenge
items.text: Team … has requested a coach’s challenge regarding the validity of the goal.

items.title: Video review — no goal
items.text: After video review it is determined that …. No goal has been scored.

items.title: Video review — goal
items.text: After video review it is determined that …. The goal is awarded.

items.title: Video review — goal + delay
items.text: After video review there is no goaltender interference. The goal is awarded. Team … is assessed a bench minor penalty for delay of game.

items.title: Minor penalty (player)
items.text: A minor penalty for … has been assessed to … (name, number), team …

items.title: Minor penalty (goalkeeper)
items.text: A minor penalty for … has been assessed to the goalkeeper of team … (name, number). The penalty is served by … (name, number).

items.title: Coincidental penalties
items.text: A minor penalty for … has been assessed to … (name, number), team … (visitors).\nA minor penalty for … has been assessed to … (name, number), team … (home).

items.title: Two minors to one player
items.text: A minor penalty for … has been assessed to … (name, number), team …. He is also assessed a minor penalty for …

items.title: Bench minor
items.text: Team … is assessed a bench minor penalty for …. The penalty is served by … (name, number).

items.title: Major + game misconduct
items.text: A major penalty and a game misconduct for … have been assessed to … (name, number), team …

items.title: Misconduct (10 min)
items.text: A misconduct penalty for … has been assessed to … (name, number), team …

items.title: Game misconduct
items.text: A game misconduct for … has been assessed to … (name, number), team …

items.title: Too many men
items.text: Team … is assessed a bench minor penalty for too many men on the ice.

items.title: Delay of game (bench)
items.text: Team … is assessed a bench minor penalty for delay of game.
